title: Descent of cycle specialization modulo rational equivalence
as_he_states: A crossed fragment asks whether the proposed specialization descends to rational equivalence under its definability condition.
plausible_today: Let R be an excellent DVR and X flat and quasi-projective over R. Closure followed by the special-fibre Gysin map defines CH_p(X_K)→CH_p(X_k). In a smooth setting it is compatible with intersection products.
state_of_art: The exact question is published in SGA6 X§7.14, equations(7.14.1–2); its final paragraph isolates the failure of the naive rational-equivalence argument. Fulton1975 §§4.1–4.4 proves the needed descent and functorial specialization under the stated excellent-DVR hypotheses.
why_open: The source itself says that special-fibre intersections used in the proposed argument need not be defined. The crossed draft visibly encounters that same obstruction; the reuse of the sheet adds no further mathematical conclusion.
worth: The mathematical problem is settled in the cited scope; the useful next task is textual comparison with the final SGA6 wording.
